title: State what must be true at a checkpoint
statement: As an architect I can list the invariants and expectations that must hold by a checkpoint, and a checkpoint passes only when each is shown to hold, so the work stays focused on its goals

acceptance_criteria.statement: A checkpoint records the expectations that must be true by the time it is reached, apart from user stories
plan pass is refused until each expectation is confirmed with how it was shown to hold, and the pass records each
plan checkpoint and the checkpoint's review list its expectations, and once it passed, how each held
plan guide names a checkpoint that states no expectations
